vetSays.line: 🛡️ Tomas, Mai, Ernesto, Kathleen and Catalina met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Tomas, Mai, Ernesto, Catalina are hurt.

regDeaths.name: a line of ducks, walking in perfect formation. In the dark. That is not normal duck behavior.
